xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4327: Add Claude Sonnet 5.5 (claude-sonnet-5-5): catalog, cost, temperature-safe calls, defaults; release to npm

plan.title: Add Claude Sonnet 5.5 (claude-sonnet-5-5): catalog, cost, temperature-safe calls, defaults; release to npm
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: Mechanical addition of one model across the catalog, cost, memory, compaction and defaults layers plus docs (~40 files counting tests). Every item is small and file-disjoint where possible; splitting into sibling issues would force several releases for one model launch that the operator wants shipped in one release today.

narratives.Problem: Anthropic released Claude Sonnet 5.5 (claude-sonnet-5-5) on 2026-09-28. Overdeck does not list, price or default to it. Overdeck's memory providers and TTS summarizer always send temperature, which returns HTTP 400 on Sonnet 5.5 and on every Sonnet 5+, Opus 4.7+ and Fable model. Claude Code 2.1.284 now resolves the 'sonnet' alias to Sonnet 5.5, so Overdeck's claude-sonnet-5 -> 'sonnet' flag mapping would launch the wrong model.
narratives.Proposal: Add a supportsSamplingParams capability flag plus modelSupportsSamplingParams() helper; register claude-sonnet-5-5 in the ModelId union, capability additions, class, provider and pricing tables, session cost normalization, compaction budget and all dashboard pickers; make memory providers and the TTS summarizer omit temperature for sampling-restricted models; pass full Sonnet IDs to claude --model; flip Sonnet-tier defaults to claude-sonnet-5-5; document the Claude Code 2.1.284 requirement and add a v0.63.0 changelog entry. Full detail: .pan/drafts/PAN-4327.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Releasing to npm; after merge the operator or flywheel runs `pan release stable --version 0.63.0` from main.
- Changing the Opus or Haiku alias rows in getClaudeModelFlag (same bug class, follow-up).
- Setting supportsSamplingParams on any GPT, Gemini or other non-Anthropic model.
- Exporting CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS for Sonnet 5.5 on Claude Code older than 2.1.284.
- Rebuilding sync-sources/hooks/record-cost-event.js (its prefix fallback already prices Sonnet 5.5 at the identical Sonnet 5 rate).
- Editing src/lib/memory/query-expansion.ts, src/lib/registry/feature-registry-population.ts or src/dashboard/server/routes/settings.ts.
- Installing, pinning or version-gating Claude Code from Overdeck.
- Changing the expensive (Opus) or cheap (Haiku) workhorse defaults.
- Changing a model the user configured explicitly.
- Removing claude-sonnet-5 from any picker or catalog.

autoDecisions.summary: Ship the defaults flip (issue item 3) in this issue.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's checkpoint condition is that installed Claude Code 2.1.280 launches --model claude-sonnet-5-5; it does (API served the request). Its degraded 200K window is fixed by upgrading to Claude Code 2.1.284, which is documented as a requirement.

autoDecisions.summary: Document 'Sonnet 5.5 requires Claude Code 2.1.284 or newer' instead of exporting CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS.
autoDecisions.rationale: Probe: 2.1.284 reports a native 1M window; 2.1.280 with CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS=1000000 still reported 200K, so the env workaround is unverified. Same pattern as the existing Fable 5.1 note.

autoDecisions.summary: Flag name supportsSamplingParams (tri-state, false only when proven) with helper modelSupportsSamplingParams next to modelSupportsImages.
autoDecisions.rationale: Mirrors the existing supportsImages precedent; unknown and dated IDs keep today's behavior.

autoDecisions.summary: Mark all sampling-restricted Anthropic models, not only Sonnet 5.5: fable-5-1, fable-5, opus-5-5, opus-5, opus-4-8, opus-4-7, sonnet-5, sonnet-5-5.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for 'any other model with the same restriction'; the Claude API thinking/sampling table lists sampling as removed (400) for exactly these.

autoDecisions.summary: Put the Sonnet 5.5 capability entry in model-capability-additions.ts after claude-fable-5-1.
autoDecisions.rationale: model-capabilities.ts is at its file-size cap; additions spread first, so Sonnet 5.5 lists before Sonnet 5 as the issue requires.

autoDecisions.summary: Fix the sonnet alias drift for the whole Sonnet family in getClaudeModelFlag; leave Opus rows for a follow-up.
autoDecisions.rationale: Claude Code 2.1.284 resolves 'sonnet' to Sonnet 5.5, and claude-sonnet-4-6 -> 'sonnet' already runs Sonnet 5; the Opus family is outside this issue's model.

autoDecisions.summary: Apply the temperature guard to the TTS summarizer although it calls api.openai.com.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue lists it; the change is a harmless request-shape guard. No GPT model gets the flag without a verified source.

autoDecisions.summary: Skip edits to query-expansion.ts, feature-registry-population.ts, routes/settings.ts, router-config.ts and record-cost-event.js.
autoDecisions.rationale: The first two reach the fixed providers via extractWithProviderPolicy; routes/settings.ts MODEL_API_IDS has no Anthropic ids; router-config.ts no longer exists; the hook bundle's prefix fallback prices Sonnet 5.5 correctly.

autoDecisions.summary: Pre-seed a v0.63.0 Update block in changelog.mdx; the npm release itself is a post-merge step.
autoDecisions.rationale: Releases run only from main via pan release stable; the release step reconciles the label if another version ships first.

autoDecisions.summary: Also flip DEFAULT_DEEP_ENRICHMENT_MODEL, getBestAnthropicAtTier and DEFAULT_SETTINGS specialists test_agent/merge_agent.
autoDecisions.rationale: They are Sonnet-tier defaults and fallbacks of the same kind the issue lists; none reads user configuration.
